description: This file defines the GetModulesParams class, which extends BaseParam. It provides methods to retrieve various parameters such as module name, fields, page, sort, filter, and deleted status. It also configures parameter options used in API parameter handling.

classes.name: GetModulesParams
classes.description: A class that manages parameters for retrieving modules, including module name, fields, pagination, sorting, and filtering options.

methods.name: getModuleName
methods.description: Returns the name of the module.

methods.name: getPage
methods.description: Returns the pagination parameters as a PageParams object.

methods.name: getDeleted
methods.description: Checks if the filter contains a deletion indicator.

methods.name: configureParameters
methods.description: Configures accepted parameters using the OptionsResolver.
